title: Quick Glassy-Jelly Ayurvedic Norwegian Monsoon Tagine
description: A rich, umami-filled, Ayurvedic-friendly dish that resembles glassy-jelly, originating from Norway's monsoon season, and enhanced with Thai red curry paste.
instructions: Heat the ghee or oil in a clay tagine over medium heat, until it shimmers.
Add the onions and saut68 until they turn translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the Thai red curry paste and stir-fry for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the sliced mushrooms and stir-fry until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced bell peppers and stir-fry for another 2 minutes, until they start to soften.
Add the chickpeas, coconut milk, fish sauce, lemon juice, and salt. Stir well to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 15 minutes, until the liquid has thickened and the flavors have melded together.
Garnish with fresh cilantro, if desired.
